purpose: Wrong reads of human-confirmed scoreboard fields that the frozen OCR versions make and that were looked at and kept on record. A version is a fixed measurement, so its reader is not patched in place; a reader fix becomes a new version (reader_options in its template file). scripts/70_refresh_ocr_reports.py prints listed reads as NOTE, and fails on any wrong read that is not listed and on any listed read that no longer happens with the same value.

misreads.label: Top

first_seen.note: First wrong (not abstained) read of a confirmed field by any version on a verified eval-set frame; found on frames added by the A-9 merge (top of the 5th), which none of the versions had seen.

misreads.evidence: outputs/frames/evalset_3314.50.jpg (ffmpeg grab at the decision frame) shows the up arrow and 5 plainly (top of the 5th, 0-2, runner on first, 0 outs); the label is right and the reader is wrong.
misreads.cause: read_topbot takes the widest row of the arrow window (x 266-279, y 46-64). The up arrow starts at x 264 on every top-of-inning frame, so the window cuts its left corner and the lower rows all measure 7-9 px. On this frame JPEG blur makes the two base rows 8 and 7 px instead of 9 and 9, so four rows tie at 8 px; argmax takes the first of them at 0.375 of the arrow span, under the 0.4 threshold, and returns Bot. The same clipping leaves 37/5 at 0.5 (abstain).
misreads.follow_up: CHECKLIST F-3d (OCR v4): a tie-robust apex rule and/or a window that covers the whole up arrow, as an opt-in reader option evaluated on frames the rule was not fixed on; v1-v3 keep this read.

first_seen.note: Found on the A-10 6th-inning rows, the first blind rows for the pre-registered v4 (and new rows for v1-v3). It is the wrong read that fails v4's pre-registered criterion (1); see game_747139_scoreboard_ocr_v4_acceptance.json. Recorded after the failure was judged, for every version that makes it, so scripts/70 keeps its gate.

misreads.evidence: outputs/frames/evalset_4058.75.jpg (and outputs/verification/a10_42_1_bug.png, a10_42_1_frames.png): a clean live centre-field frame whose bug shows the left out circle filled (1 out), matching the manifest pre-state and both verifier lenses; the label is right and the reader is wrong.
misreads.cause: The filled out circle is drawn pale at the decision frame, one grid step after the SNY logo transition wipe (4058.50): its centre pixel is RGB 167/180/126, which fails the gold mask's r - b > 50 test (41), so the out_1 window has gold fraction 0.059 <= EMPTY 0.08 and reads as empty; with out_2 empty the reader returns outs 0 instead of abstaining. The same circle reaches 0.367 at 4059.00 and 0.497 at 4060.00. The structural reader is shared by v1-v4, so every version makes this read.
misreads.follow_up: A successor version could abstain when an out or runner window is neither clearly gold nor clearly navy (e.g. a pale-fill band) instead of reading empty; that is a new pre-registered version, not a patch of v1-v4.
